I’d just finished a bowl of noodles when the call came in. #ETH 

As I wiped my mouth, an unfamiliar number popped up on the screen.

“You’re planning to withdraw 180,000 USDT this week. What’s the source of the funds?”

I said I’d made it trading crypto.

There was a pause on the other end, as if she were checking some records. Then her voice dropped a notch:

“...This account has been open for seven years and has never been liquidated?”

She didn’t sound suspicious so much as like she’d seen a ghost.

I’m no genius.

Over those seven years, plenty of people were smarter than me—and even more were bolder.

They blew up and left long ago. Some didn’t even make a ripple.

There’s only one reason I can still sit here eating noodles: fear!!

At my peak, I withdrew 180,000 in a single week. The exchange’s risk-control team called and nearly took me for a money launderer.

I wasn’t angry. I was actually relieved.

When the money’s in your account, it’s easy to get carried away. Once you withdraw it, you can’t gamble it away.

How did I make it through seven years? Just three things.

First, stash your profits away.
As soon as your gains hit 10%, immediately move half into a cold wallet. Don’t touch your principal.

In seven years, I’ve made 48 withdrawals. Every time I finish a transfer, I tell myself: food money is safe. I can take my time with the rest.

Second, bet on both sides. It doesn’t matter who wins.
The day LUNA crashed, it fell 90% in 24 hours. So many people were wiped out overnight.

My account was actually up 42% that day.
In a volatile market, it’s hard to make it to the next week if you don’t leave yourself a way out.

Third, treat stop-losses like food money.
My win rate is only 38%—I lose six out of every ten trades.
But for every dollar I lose, I can make five back. If I lose twice in a row, I shut everything down and go to sleep. I never chase a trade.

In seven years, I’ve never broken that rule.

You’re not losing money because you’re stupid. It’s because nobody told you this stuff.

Getting rich overnight is luck. Lasting seven years—that takes skill. I can’t promise you’ll double your money tomorrow.

But I can tell you what someone who’s gone seven years without getting liquidated actually does every day.

First, a definition: blobs have a separate fee market. The blob base fee automatically rises or falls depending on the gap between usage and the target, and is also burned.

When Layer 2 networks write blob data to the mainnet, the blob fee is also paid in $ETH .
Size your positions according to your risk tolerance, and leave yourself plenty of room to maneuver.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

A newcomer asked me about this recently, so I thought I’d write it down.
Ethereum blocks typically reach “finalized” status after two epochs (about 12.8 minutes).
Finality on Ethereum requires two-thirds of staked ETH to participate in voting. If too many validators go offline, finalization pauses, but blocks continue to be produced as usual.
On Ethereum, the staked $ETH  is the guarantee of finality: rewriting finalized blocks would mean losing a huge amount of stake.

以太坊市场深度分析：企业买盘与链上抛压的拉锯战

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月二十八日下午三时，以太坊现货报价两千三百五十三美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之一点六。从小时K线走势来看，ETH在亚洲时段表现出较为稳健的上行节奏。价格从凌晨的两千三百五十一美元低点起步，经过连续四根阳线攀升至两千三百六十六美元的日内高位，整体呈现出阶梯式上涨的形态。

从均线系统观察，当前价格已经有效突破了七周期均线两千三百五十八美元和二十五周期均线两千三百四十六美元。更重要的是，以太坊价格重新站上了九十九周期均线两千三百三十八美元上方，这意味着短中长期三条均线开始形成多头排列的雏形。七周期均线正在上穿二十五周期均线，形成短期的金叉信号，为后续进一步上行提供了技术面的支持。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI已经上行至七十三点一九，逼近超买区域。十二周期RSI为六十六点七零，二十四周期RSI为五十九点三二。与比特币类似，以太坊的短周期RSI同样处于较高水平，表明短期上涨动能较强，但需要关注超买后的回调可能性。

MACD指标呈现积极信号。DIFF线位于八点四七，DEA线位于七点八九，柱状图为正值零点五八。此前MACD柱状图一度收窄至接近零轴，如今重新转正并呈现扩张态势，说明多头力量正在逐步占据上风。从历史走势来看，MACD柱状图从零轴下方回升至正值区域，往往对应着一波阶段性反弹的启动。

布林带指标显示上轨位于两千三百六十八美元，中轨位于两千三百五十美元，下轨位于两千三百三十一美元。价格当前运行在布林带中轨上方并接近上轨，表明短期处于偏强运行状态。带宽持续收窄，暗示变盘节点正在临近。

KDJ指标中K线上行至六十六度，D线位于五十九度，J线达到八十度。三线同步向上发散，短期看多信号明确。威廉指标WR已经下行至负十三点七七，进入了超买区域，与RSI的高位运行形成共振，提醒投资者注意短期回调的可能性。

从量化综合信号来看，十五个因子中六个发出做多信号，八个发出做空信号，一个保持中性。做空信号占比百分之五十三点三，较比特币的百分之六十有所缓和，但仍显示中期模型对以太坊持谨慎态度。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临的核心矛盾是企业级买盘与链上抛压之间的博弈。从利好因素来看，Bitmine公司近期新增购入一万零四百五十二枚ETH，使其总持仓达到六百零五万枚ETH，约占以太坊总供应量的百分之四点九五。这种大规模的企业级持续增持为市场提供了坚实的需求基础，也反映出机构对以太坊中长期价值的认可。

现货市场的资金流入同样值得关注。过去数小时内，以太坊现货市场录得超过三千六百万美元的净流入，其中包含多笔超过两千四百七十万美元的大额买单。这些资金推动价格从两千三百一十四美元附近一路上行至当前的两千三百五十美元上方。

然而风险因素同样不容忽视。链上数据显示，ICO时代的早期持有者近期向交易所转移了超过一万两千五百枚ETH，这些潜在的抛压可能对短期价格形成压制。同时，RSI六周期从七十四点八四的高位回落至五十一度后再度反弹至七十三度，显示市场情绪在短期内经历了较大幅度的波动。

宏观层面，美联储利率决议同样是以太坊面临的关键不确定性因素。如果美联储释放鹰派信号导致风险偏好下降，以太坊作为高贝塔资产可能会承受比比特币更大的下行压力。反之，如果美联储表态偏鸽，则有望触发包括以太坊在内的风险资产普涨行情。

综合来看，以太坊在技术面上呈现出短期偏多格局，企业买盘和ETF资金流入为价格提供了有力支撑。但投资者需要警惕早期持有人的链上抛压以及美联储决议带来的宏观不确定性。建议关注两千三百七十美元附近的阻力位表现，以及两千三百三十美元附近的支撑有效性。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or a Liquidation Accelerator?
translatedData.subTitle:
Compounding positions has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several times leverage to ride a big trend, then repeat a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

[What Compounding Positions Involves] Instead of cashing out unrealized profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized profits
can go from dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

[The Math] The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% win rate each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts about doubling your money overnight come with a backstory: 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Your Position: Fortune Through Risk—or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling your position” has been all the rage lately. The stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original capital. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What rolling your position involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep trading,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding is astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains
of dozens of points can disappear to zero in just one or two huge bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of rolling your position is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts you see about doubling your money overnight come with 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

📰 Coinbase Hit by Vendor Data Leak—Why Is the Market Unfazed?

Coinbase has run into another security issue, but this time it wasn’t directly hacked. Amplitude, the company it uses for data analytics, messed up, exposing customers’ contact information. Reports say more than 70,000 people were affected. Coinbase says there’s no cause for concern: its systems weren’t compromised, and no funds were lost. But this vendor has such close ties to Coinbase that it’s no wonder some people are questioning whether Coinbase itself handled things improperly. For the crypto world, it’s yet another security issue. Will it get past the regulators?

Why does this news matter?
Coinbase and Amplitude are closely connected: Coinbase uses Amplitude’s data to analyze user behavior. This leak could reveal who people are and how to contact them, making it valuable intelligence for competitors and regulators. There’s a strange pattern in the industry: the bigger the player, the more likely it is to get hacked, because major players are prime targets for attackers. Data leaks aren’t new, but the crypto market is extremely sensitive to security concerns, and even the slightest disturbance can trigger a crisis of confidence.

Market impact
In the short term, this kind of incident could heighten anxiety among crypto users, but the market will probably shrug it off. Why? Because Coinbase itself wasn’t breached and no funds were lost, making this far less serious than a direct attack by cybercriminals. BTC and ETH barely moved today, while SOL rose, suggesting people are more focused on on-chain capital flows and the projects themselves. In the long run, though, if these vendor security incidents keep happening, regulators may step in to regulate third-party services, changing how the entire ecosystem operates.

Trading perspective
This kind of news has a limited impact on market sentiment, but it’s worth watching how vendor security practices evolve. If more similar incidents occur, it could indicate weaknesses in crypto security infrastructure, prompting the industry to adopt stricter standards. Simply put: a vendor incident that doesn’t result in lost funds is unlikely to directly affect prices, but it could reshape the industry.

这种新闻对市场情绪影响有限，但值得观察供应商安全链的演变。如果未来出现更多同类事件，可能意味着加密安全基础设施还有短板，这会推动行业向更严格的标准发展。简单说：钱没丢的供应商事件，对价格没啥直接冲击，但行业格局可能会变。

Stop telling me the ETH ETF story is about “institutions slowly building positions.” The data is right there: money is leaving.

On October 26, spot BTC ETFs saw $110 million in net inflows, all of it going to BlackRock’s IBIT. On the same day, spot ETH ETFs saw $88.58 million in outflows.
On October 27, BTC brought in another $176 million ($151.5 million for IBIT and $24.5 million for FBTC), while ETH saw another $60.2 million flow out. ETHA alone had $93.3 million in outflows.

Over the past 30 days, ETH ETFs have seen about $1.31 billion in cumulative outflows—roughly five times BTC’s outflows over the same period, even though ETH’s market cap is much smaller.

So all those people constantly shouting that “ETH/BTC is about to reverse” should explain this first: BlackRock’s own ETHA is seeing outflows, while money is flowing into its BTC product. Same issuer, two products moving in completely opposite directions. This isn’t about sentiment anymore; institutions are choosing how to allocate, and they’re not choosing the one you’re holding.

The funniest part is that ETHA’s $93.3 million in outflows exceeded the total outflows for ETH ETFs, which means other funds actually saw a small net inflow of around $30 million. But KOLs screenshot only “total outflows” or only “money is coming in”—whatever suits their narrative.

My take is simple: until ETF flows stop bleeding, treat every ETH rally as a chance to reduce your position, not as a signal to buy the dip. We can talk when ETHA has turned positive for several days in a row.

translatedData.content:
BTC options expiry tops trending list | ETH options worth about $790 million settle the same day | Not betting on a $2,500 magnetic pull

My stance is to wait and see, not go long just because of the words “max pain.” Binance Square’s trending list currently shows “#$10.9 billion in Bitcoin options expire Friday.” This isn’t just about BTC: the official Binance News account also mentioned that about $776 million in ETH options on Deribit expire at 08:00 UTC on October 30, with a stated max pain level of around $2,500. I queried Deribit’s public options API directly and filtered for contracts expiring on 30OCT26. The result was open interest of about 333,600 ETH, comprising roughly 188,300 calls and 145,300 puts. Using Kraken’s ETH price of about $2,355 at the time of the query, I estimated the notional value at roughly $786 million. The two figures are similar, but they were sampled at different times and prices, and notional open interest is not the same as net funds about to enter the spot market.

The ETH max pain level cited by Binance News is above the current price, while BTC’s reference level is below it. These are only model levels; they do not mean hedging trades will inevitably push prices toward them. Around options expiry, market makers’ dynamic hedging may amplify intraday volatility, or it may ease as time value decays. The direction depends on positions around the strike prices and real-time prices. You can’t simply infer from the number of call contracts that ETH will rise to $2,500. If BTC plunges due to month-end settlement, ETH’s model level won’t prevent overall risk appetite from declining.

Institutional flows offer another measure. According to Farside, U.S. spot ETH funds saw combined net outflows of about $60.2 million on October 27. On October 28, the entries for individual funds were still dashes, so the reported total of 0.0 should not be treated as definitive proof of zero flows. On October 28, the Federal Reserve held rates at 3.75%–4%, with two members favoring a rate hike. The macro picture has not provided a clear dovish signal for high-volatility assets. So my view is that the options narrative will add short-term noise, but the real direction still needs to be confirmed by price action, spot trading volume, and subsequent fund-flow data.

How has the market reacted so far? When I checked Kraken, ETH was around $2,355—above the day’s open of $2,347, but still below the high of $2,384. The low was about $2,320. BTC was around $81,100 at the same time. ETH has not come close to $2,500 for now, and this rebound cannot be attributed to options settlement. I see $2,384 as the short-term confirmation level and $2,320 as the invalidation level. If ETH breaks below $2,320 and fails to recover it, any short-term bullish view should be withdrawn. If it holds above $2,384 on strong volume, then I’ll watch for spot buying to follow through. $2,500 is simply a more distant area to monitor, not an unconditional target.

If I were trading myself, I would sit this one out for now, with no directional position and 0% allocated. Only if ETH breaks above $2,384 and holds on a retest, while BTC stays above its intraday low, would I consider a small spot long using 2% of my total capital. Those two conditions are the entry triggers. The first target is $2,420; I’d reduce the position by half there. I’d hold the rest only if volume remains strong as ETH approaches $2,460; otherwise, I’d close it. I’d stop out if ETH falls back to $2,350 after entry. If ETH first loses $2,320 or BTC weakens at the same time, I’d immediately cancel the plan and close the position. If the conditions aren’t met, I’ll keep waiting, avoid high leverage, and won’t present an untriggered plan as a gain.

Sources: Binance Square trending list, Binance News, Deribit public API, Kraken, Farside, and the Federal Reserve’s October 28 statement. #109亿美元比特币期权周五到期 #ETH #BTC

content:
BTC期权到期成热榜｜ETH约7.9亿美元同日结算｜不押2500美元磁吸

我的态度是观望，不因“最大痛点”四个字追多。币安广场热榜当前显示“#109亿美元比特币期权周五到期”。这不只是 BTC 的事：币安 News 官方账号同时提到，10月30日08:00 UTC，Deribit 上还有约7.76亿美元 ETH 期权到期，给出的最大痛点约2500美元。我直接读取 Deribit 公共期权接口，筛选30OCT26到期合约，得到约33.36万枚 ETH 未平仓量，看涨约18.83万枚、看跌约14.53万枚；按查询时 Kraken ETH 约2355美元粗算，名义金额约7.86亿美元。两组数字相近，但各自取样时间和价格不同，未平仓名义金额也不是即将进入现货市场的净资金。

币安 News 给出的 ETH 最大痛点在现价上方，而 BTC 的参考位在现价下方；这只是模型点位，并非对冲交易必然把价格推过去。期权到期时，做市商的动态对冲可能放大盘中波动，也可能随着时间价值衰减而减弱，方向取决于执行价附近的仓位和实时价格，不能简单用看涨合约多就推断 ETH 会涨到2500美元。若 BTC 因月末结算急跌，ETH 的模型点位也挡不住整体风险偏好回落。

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Adding: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend right and want to add to your position—but how? Going all-in right away and adding to the max with unrealized profits is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A regular. The right approach is called pyramid adding.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position additions should be. This keeps the bulk of your cost basis low, so you can weather a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the highs. Even a slight pullback can turn a profit into a loss. Once you lose your nerve, all your trading decisions go off the rails.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why Being Able to Take Losses Helps You Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in starting capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 USDT on any one trade. After 10 consecutive losing trades, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can get you back to break-even. On the other hand, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital—you’d need to nearly double it to break even. Mathematically, you’re practically out of the game.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

A coin-margined long position of 614 ETH, with a liquidation price of 1,603. The current price is 2,360.4, giving it a paper buffer of about 32%. But that figure is misleading for a coin-margined long: the collateral itself is ETH, so when the price falls, both the margin and the position lose value, bringing liquidation closer than it appears.

First, let's break down the structure. At the current price, this long position has a notional value of about $1.45 million. A 32% buffer corresponds to roughly $757 of downside, but that is price room, not margin room. The 8-hour funding rate is +0.0100%, or about 11% annualized. For a USD-margined long, funding is a cost of holding the position; for a coin-margined long, funding is a minor concern—the collateral is the bigger one. This position is essentially a bet that ETH will rise, using ETH as collateral, so the collateral and the position share the same beta. If ETH falls 10%, the collateral's USD value shrinks by 10%, while the long position continues to lose value in ETH terms. The USD-denominated margin ratio will therefore fall faster than the price. So 1,603 is not a safety line that scales proportionally: the closer the price gets to it, the more concentrated the pressure to add margin or face forced position reductions becomes.

Looking at the market, ETH is up 0.60% over 24 hours, with $5.81 billion in 24-hour volume and $5.574 billion in open interest. Long accounts make up 76.6%. Accounts are tilted long, but the price has only moved up 0.60%, while open interest remains high. There are plenty of traders, but price hasn't moved much—suggesting that some of these longs aren't chasing the price with perpetual-futures leverage. For coin-margined longs, this is actually a blind spot: they may think they aren't paying high funding rates, while overlooking that their collateral and position move in the same direction. The long-account ratio reflects sentiment; collateral correlation is the real risk.

On the macro front, BTC is hovering around 81,400 as markets await the Fed, with a 92% probability priced in for no change. On Friday, $10.9 billion worth of BTC options also expire, with a max pain price of 78,000, about 4% below spot. During this event window, USD-margined longs at least have cash collateral they can add. Coin-margined longs use ETH as margin; if the market pulls back, adding margin means selling spot or acquiring more ETH, and liquidity can thin out further during a decline. The price doesn't actually need to reach 1,603—shrinking collateral could trigger a margin call first.

So in the short term, I wouldn't chase ETH longs or treat 1,603 as a safety cushion. If you want bullish exposure, USD-margined positions with low leverage are preferable. Don't use spot ETH directly as collateral to weather adverse moves. If you already hold a coin-margined long, first work out what your margin ratio would be if the price fell to 2,000 or 1,800, rather than focusing only on the liquidation price. Position structure matters more than directional calls; understand the correlation between your collateral and your position before making a move.

614 枚 ETH 的币本位多单，爆仓价 1603。现价 2360.4，纸面缓冲约 32%，但这个数字对币本位多头有欺骗性：抵押品本身就是 ETH，价格下跌时，保证金和仓位会同时亏损，爆仓价因此比看上去更近。

先拆结构。按现价折算，这笔多单名义约 145 万美元；32% 的缓冲对应约 757 美元的下跌空间，但这是价格空间，不是保证金空间。8h 资金费率 +0.0100%，折年约 11%。对美元本位多头，费率是持有成本；对币本位多头，费率只是小账，大账在抵押品。这笔仓位本质是用 ETH 赌 ETH 涨，抵押品和仓位共享同一个 Beta。ETH 跌 10%，抵押品的美元价值缩水 10%，同时多头仓位继续亏 ETH，美元计价的保证金率下降会快于价格跌幅。所以 1603 不是一条等比例的安全线，越靠近它，追加保证金和被动减仓的压力越集中。

盘面这边，ETH 24h +0.60%，24h 成交 58.1 亿美元，持仓量 55.74 亿美元，多头账户占比 76.6%。账户偏多，但价格只走了 +0.60%，持仓量不低——人多，价格没有拉开，说明这批多头里有一部分不是靠永续杠杆追价。对币本位多头，这反而是盲点：他们觉得自己没付高费率，却忽略了抵押品和仓位同向。账户占比是情绪，抵押品相关性才是风险。

宏观层面，BTC 在 81,400 附近等 Fed，市场给 92% 的按兵不动概率；周五还有 109 亿美元 BTC 期权到期，最大痛点 78,000，比现货低约 4%。事件窗口里，美元本位多头至少还有现金保证金可以补，币本位多头的保证金是 ETH，一旦回撤，补保证金本身就要动现货或换更多 ETH，流动性在下跌中会更薄。1603 不需要真的到，抵押品缩水就可能先触发追加保证金。

所以短线我不追多 ETH，也不会把 1603 当安全垫。真要表达多头，优先美元本位、低杠杆，别把现货 ETH 直接当保证金去扛反向波动；如果已经持有币本位多单，先算清楚跌到 2000、1800 时保证金率还剩多少，而不是只盯爆仓价。仓位结构比方向判断更重要，先算清楚抵押品和仓位的相关性再动手。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market does, the less you want to
sell; then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage 1: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third to lock in some profits.
At this point, the trade can no longer end in a loss, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage 2: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by another third. Stage 3: Trail a stop on the rest; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Exit the whole position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you'll often ride the elevator back to square one.

$BTC $ETH $SOL The Fed hits the “pause button” for a second consecutive meeting: rates stay unchanged, while internal divisions and December expectations heat up

On October 28, Washington time, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted 10–2 to keep the federal funds target range unchanged at 3.75%–4.00%, in line with market expectations. This was the Fed’s second consecutive meeting of holding rates steady, but things were far from calm internally.

Two dissenting votes: Some think policy isn’t “tight enough”
Fed Governor Cook and Cleveland Fed President Hammack, who voted against the decision, both argued for a 25-basis-point rate hike at this meeting. This stands in contrast to the unanimous vote to raise rates in September, showing that Fed officials are divided over how restrictive current policy is.

Statement and Powell’s remarks: Inflation remains high, policy is close to “neutral”
The statement retained a hawkish tone, bluntly saying that “inflation remains elevated” and emphasizing that economic activity is expanding at a solid pace. Overall annual inflation stood at 3.7% in September, while core inflation rebounded to 2.6%. Combined with an unemployment rate of 4.2%, this leaves the Fed with neither an urgent need to raise rates nor room to turn dovish.
At the press conference, Powell said the current policy rate is close to a “neutral level” and that the future path depends entirely on the data. He also mounted an unusually forceful defense of the Fed’s independence, stressing that monetary policy should not be directly controlled by elected officials.

Market reaction: “Buy everything”
Around the announcement, markets displayed the unusual pattern of risk assets and safe-haven assets rising together: U.S. stocks edged up, the dollar index dipped briefly, and spot gold climbed to around $4,043 an ounce. Bitcoin strengthened after finding support at $80,000, while the 10-year Treasury yield remained below 5%.

The real suspense lies in December
A “pause” does not mean an “end.” After the decision, traders maintained expectations of roughly a 90% probability of a Fed rate hike in December. Markets are pricing in this decision as a “skip” rather than an “end.” With high inflation and economic resilience pulling in opposite directions, the Fed has chosen to use time to gather information. Data over the next six weeks will be key to determining the direction of policy.

📰 Why Is Bitcoin Still Racing Toward $81K While the Fed Stands Pat?

The Federal Reserve announced that it would keep interest rates unchanged, but hinted that inflation remains stubborn. Just as the news broke, Bitcoin still held firmly above the $80K mark and geared up to test $81K. For the crypto market, this is both good news and a test: the Fed didn’t raise rates, so at least the short-term risks are limited. But for crypto assets to break through $81K, they’ll have to prove themselves.

The Fed’s interest rate decisions set the pace for global capital flows. This time, standing pat means global markets don’t have to worry about a sudden liquidity shock. For a highly volatile asset like Bitcoin, that gives the market some breathing room. More importantly, though, the Fed acknowledged that inflation hasn’t come down, hinting that there may still be room for future rate hikes. This means Bitcoin can attract inflows even when the Fed isn’t raising rates—if it performs well on its own. Put simply: the Fed is keeping its foot on the brake, but Bitcoin has to step on the gas.

Market impact
For BTC, the Fed standing pat is one of the most favorable policy environments right now. After all, expectations of rate hikes are a key factor weighing on crypto assets, and that factor is now off the table. But BTC can’t rely entirely on the Fed to break through $81K. Historically, Bitcoin has often needed two conditions to break through major price levels: 1) The Fed is not shifting toward rate hikes; 2) Bitcoin’s own fundamentals (such as network activity and institutional interest) are showing positive signs. At the moment, the Fed not raising rates only satisfies the first condition. As for the second, Bitcoin needs to prove itself. If BTC can hold near $81K and attract more inflows, the chances of breaking through that level will rise considerably. If the move proves to be short-lived, $81K could well become resistance.

💡 In the short term, the Fed not raising rates could be a potential tailwind for BTC, but a break above $81K still needs support from Bitcoin’s own fundamentals. This view would no longer hold if BTC sees rising trading volume but stalls above $81K.

1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

📰 Just said Solana is betting on 150ms finality, and now it suddenly has a new weapon

A couple of days ago, we talked about how Solana plans to win people back with faster speeds after the Alpenglow upgrade. Now, this foundational upgrade has also introduced new validator nodes and developer tools. Put simply, Solana is addressing its shortcomings on two fronts: rolling out a new node version for major computing-power providers, while giving programmers a new toolkit. This is important for repairing the Solana ecosystem, especially for projects held back by legacy technology.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying issue is that the Solana ecosystem prioritized speed too heavily in its early days, sacrificing stability and making many projects hesitant to use it. The Alpenglow upgrade addresses the underlying speed bottleneck. The new nodes and developer tools are meant to show everyone that the old Solana’s problems have been fixed and that the new version is more stable. In the current market cycle, this is a “technical stabilization” signal that could encourage institutional investors to take another look. It is not closely connected to other recent events; this is mainly Solana addressing its own early technical debt.

Market impact
For Solana itself, this is a short-term sentiment catalyst. The new node version and toolkit mean less friction for project development, which could bring capital back. The impact on BTC and ETH prices appears limited for now, but SOL may be the first to show a reaction. A similar historical example is the surge in ecosystem projects after Cardano’s Alonzo upgrade. Solana is now following a similar path.

Trading strategy
Solana shows signs of a short-term recovery, but we need to watch for real growth in use cases after the Alpenglow upgrade. If no projects use the new nodes, the impact will be limited. If SOL can hold above $105, it may attract investor interest. If the Alpenglow upgrade delivers only modest results, this positive news may be priced in too quickly.

Fed holds rates steady by a 10–2 vote | ETH remains near 2,340 | Don’t mistake a pause for easing

My stance is to remain cautious, observe first, and not chase the first move. The Fed’s official statement on October 28 said that the target range for the federal funds rate would remain at 3.75% to 4.00%, with a 10–2 vote; the two dissenters wanted a 25-basis-point hike this time. The September meeting saw a 25-basis-point hike, so this time was a pause in rate hikes, not a cut. The statement still described economic activity as strong and inflation as elevated, and said more information was needed to determine the policy stance. For risk assets, rates not rising further avoids an immediate increase in financing pressure, but the two votes in favor of a hike and the wording on inflation also limit any interpretation of a “pivot to easing.” The chair’s press conference is still underway, so there is no basis for declaring the December path settled.

The relationship with ETH mainly runs through three channels: the cost of dollar funding, risk appetite, and fund flows. Higher short-term rates raise the opportunity cost of holding volatile assets; if rate expectations are revised down in the future, ETH could benefit from improved risk appetite, but that is an inference, not a direct promise in this statement. Farside’s data show that on October 27, U.S. spot ETH funds saw combined net outflows of about $60.2 million, including about $93.3 million out of ETHA and about $28.6 million into FETH. The October 28 data had not yet been reported, and the automatically generated zero total on the page should not be interpreted as genuine zero flows. BTC funds had net inflows of about $176 million on the 27th, indicating that institutional demand was not strengthening in sync across different cryptocurrencies.

The market reaction is also not yet enough to confirm a breakout. When I checked Kraken’s public quotes, ETH was around $2,345, with a daily open of about $2,347, a low of $2,319.54, and a high of $2,383.77; BTC was around $80,831. After the statement was released, ETH remained close to its daily open and was nowhere near recovering its daily high. In the short term, first watch whether it can stabilize around 2,350, then whether it can break above 2,384 on increased volume; if it falls back below 2,320, the market’s interpretation of this pause in rate hikes is weak. These prices are just a snapshot of the order book at that moment; they could change quickly during the press conference, and static figures are no guarantee of execution.

If I were trading myself, I would stay out for now and keep only a contingency plan for a small spot long. After the main points from the press conference are out, I would enter using 3% of my total funds only if ETH breaks above 2,384 and then holds 2,380 on at least one retest. The initial target would be 2,420; I would take half off there and hold the rest for 2,460. After entry, I would stop out if it falls back below 2,340; if it falls below 2,320, I would close the entire position whether or not the target has been reached. If it first breaks below 2,319.54, the long thesis is invalidated outright, and I would stay flat until a new range forms. If the press conference signals a stronger inclination to raise rates, I would not loosen my stop-loss on the spur of the moment just because of an intraday bounce. This is a conditional plan; no trade has been executed, and there are no profits to review.

#FOMC会议 #ETH #BTC

我的态度是继续克制，先观察，不追第一根波动。刚刚美联储10月28日正式声明写明，联邦基金目标区间维持在3.75%至4.00%，表决为10比2；两位反对者希望本次上调25个基点。9月会议曾上调25个基点，因此这次是暂停加息，并非降息。声明仍称经济活动强劲、通胀偏高，需积累更多信息决定政策立场。对风险资产来说，利率没有继续抬升避免了即刻新增的融资压力，但两张支持加息的反对票和通胀措辞也限制了“转向宽松”的解释。主席记者会尚未完整展开，此时把12月路径说死没有依据。

这与ETH的关系主要经过美元资金成本、风险偏好和基金资金三条路径。较高的短端利率会提高持有波动资产的机会成本；若未来利率预期下修，ETH可能受益于风险偏好改善，但这是推论，不是本次声明直接承诺。Farside可查的10月27日美国ETH现货基金合计净流出约6020万美元，其中ETHA流出约9330万美元、FETH流入约2860万美元。10月28日数据仍未填报，页面自动生成的合计零不可解读为真实零流量。此前BTC基金在27日净流入约1.76亿美元，说明不同币种的机构需求没有同步走强。

市场反应目前也不足以确认突破。我核对Kraken公开报价时，ETH约2345美元，日开约2347，日低2319.54，日高2383.77；BTC约80831美元。声明发布后ETH仍贴近日开，远未收复日高。短线先看2350一带能否稳定，再看2384能否放量突破；若跌回2320下方，则市场对这次暂停加息的解读偏弱。这里的价格只是当时盘口快照，记者会期间可能快速变化，不能拿静态数字当成交保证。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只保留现货试多预案。等记者会主要信息落地，ETH突破2384并至少一次回踩守住2380，我才用总资金的3%入场；目标先看2420，达到后减半，余仓看2460。入场后若重新跌破2340就止损，若跌破2320则无论是否触及目标都平清；若先跌破2319.54，做多判断直接作废，空仓等待新的区间形成。若记者会释放更强的加息倾向，也不因盘中反抽临时放宽止损。这是条件计划，尚未成交，更没有可复盘的利润。

You won 7 out of 10 trades… so why is your balance lower?

The win rate measures how often you win, not how much money you make. That’s why “70% accuracy” alone isn’t enough to evaluate a trader or strategy.

A hypothetical example of ten closed trades:
• 7 winning trades, each earning $5: $35 total.
• 3 losing trades, each losing $20: $60 total.
Result: a $25 loss before fees, despite winning 70% of the trades!

The key point: with an average profit of $5 and an average loss of $20, you need an 80% win rate to break even before costs—and a higher rate to make a profit.

Your practical next step: review your execution history and calculate your average profit and average loss in dollars, after fees. Don’t just count the green markers, and don’t rely on theoretical targets instead of actual results.

These are illustrative calculations; ten trades aren’t enough to prove a strategy’s quality, and past results don’t guarantee they’ll happen again.

ربحت 7 صفقات من 10… فلماذا نقص رصيدك؟

نسبة الصفقات الرابحة تقيس عدد مرات الفوز، لا مقدار المال الذي كسبته. لذلك لا تكفي عبارة «دقة 70%» لتقييم متداول أو استراتيجية.

مثال افتراضي لعشر صفقات مغلقة:
• 7 صفقات رابحة، ربح كل منها 5 دولارات: المجموع 35 دولارًا.
• 3 صفقات خاسرة، خسارة كل منها 20 دولارًا: المجموع 60 دولارًا.
النتيجة: خسارة 25 دولارًا قبل الرسوم، رغم الفوز في 70% من الصفقات!

المعلومة الأهم: مع متوسط ربح 5 ومتوسط خسارة 20 دولارًا، تحتاج نسبة فوز 80% للتعادل قبل التكاليف، وأعلى منها لتحقيق ربح.

خطوتك العملية: راجع سجل التنفيذ، واحسب متوسط الربح ومتوسط الخسارة بالدولار بعد الرسوم. لا تكتف بعدّ العلامات الخضراء، ولا تعتمد الأهداف النظرية بدل النتائج الفعلية.

هذه حسابات توضيحية؛ عشر صفقات لا تثبت جودة استراتيجية، والنتائج السابقة لا تضمن تكرارها.

📰 Solana co-founder speaks out: Embrace tokenized securities or go private—innovation or control?

A Solana co-founder publicly called out companies opposed to trading tokenized stocks in the U.S., suggesting they might as well go private. The debate reflects the tension between financial innovation and regulatory control, and could reshape how the entire public market system works.

Why does this news matter?
At the heart of this conflict is the fact that tech companies want stocks to be traded as easily as cryptocurrencies, while regulators worry they could become a “digital casino.” The Solana co-founder’s message was clear: accept the new rules or leave the public markets. This means companies may have to adapt to the digital wave or stick to the traditional path, directly affecting the barriers to going public and market activity.

Market impact
Although Solana’s own share price rose 0.85% to $101.67, this development is a signal for the broader market. In the short term, the crypto community may discuss this “accept it or leave” regulatory approach more often. In the long term, if more companies choose to go private, the number of shares circulating in the market could shrink, potentially hindering innovation. There have been similar debates in the past, such as discussions about tighter regulation after the 2008 financial crisis. But that was broad-based regulation, whereas this time the focus is specifically on digital assets.

Trading approach
This suggests regulatory issues may heat up in the short term, putting pressure on the broad adoption of crypto assets. However, if regulators ultimately come up with a balanced framework, it could benefit platforms willing to embrace innovation. If $BTC and $ETH continue trading in the 2.3K-81K range, this regulatory tug-of-war could add another dimension to market volatility.

📰 Solana联合创始人喊话：不拥抱证券化就私有化，创新还是控制？

Solana的联合创始人公开发对那些反对美国证券化股票交易的公司喊话，建议他们干脆私有化算了。这场争论其实反映的是金融创新和监管控制之间的矛盾，可能让整个公共市场体系的玩法都变样。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这场冲突的核心是：科技公司想让股票也能像加密货币那样方便交易，但监管机构担心变成"数字赌场"。Solana联合创始人的话很直接——要么接受新规则，要么离开公共市场。这意味着，未来公司要么适应数字化浪潮，要么选择传统道路，这会直接影响上市门槛和市场活跃度。

对市场的影响
虽然Solana自己股价$101.67涨了0.85%，但这件事对整个市场是个信号。短期内，加密圈可能会更多讨论这种"要么接受要么离开"的监管思路。长期看，如果越来越多公司选择私有化，可能会减少市场上流动的股票数量，反而不利于创新。历史上有过类似争议，比如2008年金融危机后监管收紧的讨论，但那次是全面监管，这次是针对数字资产的专项监管。

操作思路
这意味着短期内监管话题可能会升温，对加密资产的普适性玩法有压制效应。不过如果监管最终设计出平衡机制，反而可能利好那些愿意拥抱创新的平台。如果未来$BTC$ETH继续在2.3K-81K区间震荡，这种监管博弈可能会让波动更有层次感。

📰 Why Did the French Senate Approve OECD Crypto Tax Data Sharing? Does It Loosen or Tighten Global Regulation?

The French Senate has approved the OECD’s cryptocurrency tax data-sharing framework, meaning that information about crypto transactions involving fiat currency counterparties could be accessed in the future. This marks a major shift in global regulation and puts pressure on regulators in countries such as the United States, which have yet to clearly commit to the framework.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying issue is the fragmented nature of global cryptocurrency regulation. Tax authorities in various countries have long struggled to verify the “true economic substance” of crypto transactions, allowing tax avoidance and arbitrage to proliferate. The OECD framework centers on establishing an “automatic exchange of regulatory information” mechanism—essentially using technology to break down barriers between sovereign jurisdictions. It comes at a time of intense regulatory pressure on the industry and aligns with the recent trend of countries stepping up enforcement, with a more direct impact on highly liquid, globally traded tokens like Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Market impact
The short-term effect on BTC/ETH may be positive for sentiment, but the long-term impact depends on how effectively the framework is implemented. The potential chain of effects:
- Higher tax compliance costs could force some arbitrage capital to exit, but the cross-border nature of cryptocurrency means funds may flow to jurisdictions with looser regulations.
- BTC may be more affected, as its store-of-value characteristics mean more institutional players (such as pension funds) need to consider tax compliance.
- Greater regulatory transparency could attract traditional financial institutions, but it could also enable regulators to target illegal activity more precisely, making this a double-edged sword.

Trading perspective
💡 My view is that ETH will be more affected than BTC because it is more internationalized, and much of the capital brought in by recent L2 scaling has been driven by arbitrage. If the United States also joins the OECD framework in the future, this positive catalyst could add to the current price near $2,333.69. If this data sharing creates a closed loop in global regulation, ETH could gain long-term structural support.

📰 法参议院为何批准OECD加密税数据共享？对全球监管是松是紧？

法国参议院通过了经合组织（OECD）的加密货币税数据共享框架，意味着未来能获取法币交易对手的加密货币交易信息。这对全球监管是一个重大变化，尤其对像美国等还没明确参与该框架的监管机构构成压力。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因在于全球加密货币监管的碎片化。各国税管机构长期苦于无法核实加密交易的"真实经济实质"，导致避税套利泛滥。OECD框架的核心是建立"监管信息自动交换"机制，本质是用技术手段打破主权壁垒。它处于行业周期中的监管强压期，与近期各国加大执法力度的趋势一致，特别是对比特币和以太坊这类全球流通度高的代币影响更直接。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH的影响短期是情绪利好，但长期取决于框架实际落地效果。具体影响链路：
- 税收合规成本提升会迫使部分套利资金退出，但加密货币的跨境特性意味着资金可能流向监管更宽松的地区
- 对BTC的影响更大，因其价值存储属性导致更多机构化玩家（如养老基金）需要考虑税合规问题
- 监管透明度提升可能吸引传统金融机构，但也会让监管更精准地打击非法活动，存在两面性

操作思路
💡 看法上认为对ETH比BTC影响更大，因为ETH的国际化程度更高，且近期L2扩容带来的资金更多是套利性质。如果未来美国也加入OECD框架，这个利好会叠加到当前$2,333.69附近的价格上。意味着如果这个数据共享能形成全球监管闭环，ETH可能获得长期结构性支撑。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

【State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. That doesn’t mean you should immediately
shorting; rather, at this stage, be especially cautious about chasing longs and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Funding rates remain negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to exit has already done so, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in history began at moments like this.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange only collects and passes on the money; it doesn’t profit from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how does their price stay aligned with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
This back-and-forth flow of money pulls the contract price toward the spot price.

📰 Solana cuts transaction finality to 150 ms—but how fast is that, really?

Solana launched its new consensus protocol, Alpenglow, on mainnet on the 21st. Its goal is to cut transaction finality from several seconds to 150 milliseconds. This is a key step toward speeding up network performance, and a development worth watching across the Layer 1 sector.

Why does this matter?
The core aim of the upgrade is to reduce transaction confirmation delays while maintaining Solana’s high performance. Put simply, it addresses the user complaint that “it’s fast, but you still have to wait a few seconds.” In the Layer 1 race, that can be a matter of survival: if users find that a competing network confirms transactions faster, traffic is bound to shift. And by upgrading its underlying protocol directly, Solana is signaling that it has the confidence to tackle technical bottlenecks—not just patch over them.

Market impact
In the short term, this technical breakthrough could lift sentiment around SOL, but it’s worth remembering that this is one milestone in Solana’s years-long development, not a sudden piece of good news. BTC and ETH, by comparison, are currently more focused on macroeconomic conditions and developments in their own ecosystems. Solana’s progress alone is unlikely to lift the broader market directly. However, if Solana can reliably achieve 150 ms finality, it could attract some DeFi users who are sensitive to speed. Over the long term, that could affect the Web3 infrastructure landscape.

How to approach it
Technically, this upgrade looks more beneficial than harmful, but its real-world performance remains to be seen. If SOL can stay above $100 over the next few weeks and on-chain activity doesn’t drop sharply, the technical breakthrough will have begun to deliver real value. Otherwise, it may prove to be only a short-lived spike.

This view no longer holds if network congestion or other issues prevent performance from meeting expectations.

Bitcoin (BTC) once again attempted to break above its 50-day moving average, but ultimately fell back. This move came ahead of the release of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting results and coincided with earnings season for major tech companies. This suggests that bullish momentum has temporarily faded, with the market waiting for clearer signals.

Why does this news matter?
The key point is how BTC is performing at the important technical level of the 50-day moving average. The 50-day moving average is not only a reference point for short-term trends, but often also serves as a dividing line where market participants take long or short positions at key levels. In the current market environment, BTC's hesitation may reflect several underlying factors:

1. **Macroeconomic risks weighing on the market**: Although the Federal Reserve may signal rate cuts, the market is still digesting the effects of recent global inflation data and volatility in U.S. stocks. The crypto market's high volatility makes it more sensitive to monetary policy.
2. **Technical resistance confirmed**: BTC has been rejected near the 50-day moving average several times, suggesting that sufficient selling pressure has built up at this level. This indicates that bears are mounting a strong defense at a key level.
3. **Industry events converging**: Tech earnings season often affects risk appetite, while the outcome of the Federal Reserve meeting could determine the future direction of monetary policy. Between these two major events, the market has chosen to wait and see.

Market impact
The main factor currently influencing BTC's price is the balance between bullish and bearish forces. In the short term, BTC may continue to fluctuate near the 50-day moving average because:

1. **Short-term sentiment is in control**: If the FOMC meeting outcome falls short of expectations, BTC may face further pressure; conversely, it could receive temporary support.
2. **Changes in capital flows**: The performance of tech stocks during earnings season may affect institutional allocations, thereby influencing capital inflows into the crypto market. For example, if major tech companies report weaker-than-expected earnings, some risk capital may be withdrawn, increasing selling pressure on BTC.
3. **Historical precedent**: Historically, after failing to break above the 50-day moving average, BTC has often entered a longer period of consolidation. For example, in March 2022 and February 2024, BTC showed similar hesitation before undergoing several months of pullbacks.

Trading approach
At present, BTC's movement near the 50-day moving average may indicate a lack of clear short-term direction. If the FOMC meeting outcome is dovish, it could briefly boost market sentiment. In the longer term, however, BTC still needs to address the underlying issue of capital outflows. 比特币（BTC）再次尝试突破50天移动平均线，但价格最终回落。这个动作发生在美联储（FOMC）会议结果公布之前，同时伴随着关键科技公司的财报季。BTC未能成功穿越这个被市场广泛视为趋势转折点的均线，显示多头力量暂时衰竭，市场在等待更明确的信号。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条新闻的关键在于BTC在50天均线这个重要技术水平的表现。50天均线不仅是短期趋势的参照，也常常成为资金在关键位置进行多空分水的分界线。在当前市场环境下，BTC的犹豫不决可能反映了以下几个深层逻辑：

1. **宏观风险压制**：尽管美联储可能暗示降息，但市场仍在消化近期全球通胀数据和美股波动的影响。加密市场的高波动性使其对宏观货币政策的反应更为敏感。
2. **技术阻力确认**：BTC多次在50天均线附近受阻，说明这个价位已经积累了足够的抛压。这表明空头在关键位置展现了较强的防御能力。
3. **行业事件叠加**：科技财报季通常会影响市场风险偏好，而美联储会议的结果则可能决定货币政策的未来走向。在两个重要事件之间，市场选择暂时观望。

对市场的影响
当前影响BTC价格的核心因素在于多空力量的平衡状态。短期内，BTC可能继续在50天均线附近震荡，因为：

1. **短期情绪主导**：如果FOMC会议结果不及预期，BTC可能进一步承压；反之，则可能获得短暂支撑。
2. **资金流向变化**：科技股财报季的表现可能影响机构资金配置，进而影响加密市场的资金流入。例如，如果大型科技公司的财报不及预期，可能会抽离部分风险资金，增加BTC的抛压。
3. **历史参考**：历史上，BTC在突破50天均线失败后，往往会进入更长时间的整理期。例如，在2022年3月和2024年2月，BTC均出现了类似的犹豫表现，随后经历了数月的回调。

操作思路
目前来看，BTC在50天均线附近的徘徊可能意味着短期内缺乏明确的方向。如果FOMC会议结果鸽派，可能会短暂提振市场情绪，但长期来看，BTC仍需解决根本性的资金流出问题。更关键的观察点在于，如果ETH或其他主要山寨币无法突破各自的关键阻力位，可能会引发连锁抛压。

**一句话翻译：钱没有离开股市，但开始不愿意全部挤在最热门的科技股里了。**

📰 Why are companies storing money on the blockchain?

A recent survey by Singapore’s DBS Bank found that 88% of large companies worldwide are already using or testing tokenized money. Stablecoins are leading the way, while traditional banking hours are becoming a constraint that companies want to escape. This shows that corporate treasury management is rapidly embracing digital currencies.

Why does this news matter?
Companies are at the heart of the financial system, so their choices can point the way forward. This large-scale shift to tokenized money means the efficiency of fund transfers may be redefined. Why? Simply put, traditional banking systems are beginning to lag significantly behind blockchain technology in speed and cost.

Market impact
For companies, this means they can complete tasks such as cross-border payments and asset custody more quickly. What does this mean for BTC and ETH? It means institutional funds are looking for new, more efficient avenues. While the direct impact on prices may be limited in the short term, over the long term, if corporate tokenized money pools continue to grow, they could divert some demand away from traditional cryptocurrencies.

Trading approach
Market sentiment is currently cautious overall. The figure of 88% indicates that tokenized money has moved from the pilot stage into the mainstream. This means that in the coming years, corporate funds will engage with blockchain more frequently. If tighter regulations emerge in the future and crack down on corporate tokenization, this thesis no longer holds.

My stance is to avoid chasing the move for now. Binance Square’s trending list is discussing “#BitMine increased holdings by 10,452 ETH,” but this number should currently be viewed as the market’s attribution judgment of an on-chain address, and cannot be directly written as the company having completed a new purchase. After checking BitMine’s investor relations page and its SEC filings, the only confirmed fact is that the company announced on Oct 26 that it held about 6.05 million ETH, roughly 4.95% of the circulating supply at the time; there is no formal holdings update on the page for Oct 28 regarding 10,452 ETH. Even if the address did receive a transfer, it could involve custody, internal transfers, or staking, and both account ownership and transaction nature require company disclosure before a conclusion can be made.

Why does this matter? Corporate treasury buying changes freely tradable supply and market expectations; if it enters staking, it also changes immediately sellable supply. But this kind of structural demand is not a guarantee of support for every 15-minute candle. Farside statistics showed that on Oct 27, total net outflows from U.S. spot ETH funds were $60.2 million, and the Oct 28 entry was still not fully reported, so “0” cannot be treated as meaning there were no outflows that day. Corporate treasuries are more long-term, while fund subscriptions and redemptions are short-term; the two flows can point in opposite directions, so both need to be considered when judging the current trade.

The market has already given a restrained response: when I checked Kraken, ETH/USD was around $2,329, below the day’s open of $2,347, with an intraday range of roughly $2,319 to $2,384. The result of the Federal Reserve’s October meeting is still awaiting the official statement; if rate expectations drive both the dollar and risk assets to move together, ETH’s short-term elasticity could be amplified.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one without thinking and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market move, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They support each other in the same basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spill over to other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case outcome of a bad trade

Optimum has been touting “$5.78 billion in Total Value Boosted” this week. I stared at it for a while, and the more I looked, the more it seemed like TVL wearing a disguise.

Let’s break it down. TVB is the staked ETH held by validators running their mump2p network layer. On launch day, it was about 1.4 million ETH, supposedly worth $3.4 billion. A week later, they said it had grown by 1.09 million to 2.49 million ETH, or about $5.78 billion. Not a cent went into Optimum. Node operators just swapped out a broadcasting component, and all the ETH they had staked got counted in full. When a heavyweight like ether.fi joins, the number takes off—this has absolutely nothing to do with “users pouring in.” Even their own community account explained in a reply that “TVB is not TVL,” so why insist on putting a dollar figure in the headline?

I’m not knocking the technology itself. RLNC network coding, developed with the involvement of an MIT professor, reportedly speeds up block propagation by 335 ms and reduces erroneous head votes by 51%. If true, that’s good for Ethereum. But these are figures reported by the project itself and compared against native GossipSub; I haven’t seen any third-party replication. And even the number of operators isn’t consistent: one post says 16, another says 26 “validators and staking protocols.” They can’t even agree on their own counting criteria.

The most telling data is actually on their promotional account: today’s posts saying “5.78 BILLION in ONE WEEK” got 39, 30, and 58 views. They had more replies than likes, and one commenter’s handle was literally “Optimum soldier.” Add in a collection of 999 soulbound NFTs. We all know this playbook: infrastructure projects pump up the numbers and build a community first. I’ll let you guess what comes next.

Network-layer improvements are worth keeping an eye on. Just ignore figures like “billions.”

📰 Why does France want to share BTC transaction data with 46 jurisdictions?

France plans to share cryptocurrency transaction data with 46 jurisdictions around the world. This could significantly improve tax compliance globally and have a profound impact on the international cryptocurrency regulatory landscape.

Why does this news matter?
France’s move is not an isolated event; it is part of a broader global trend toward tighter crypto regulation. Why is France doing this? The root cause is loopholes in tax compliance. In recent years, the anonymity and cross-border nature of cryptocurrency transactions have made tax evasion possible. As a European financial center, France naturally wants to close this loophole. This is not simply about domestic issues in France; it is also an active effort to coordinate global regulation. Joining forces with 46 jurisdictions will make it more efficient to combat cross-border money laundering and tax evasion. It marks an accelerating regulatory shift from “every country for itself” to “global coordination and enforcement.”

What does this mean for the market? Simply put, regulatory transparency is increasing. In the past, many transactions took place in regulatory vacuums. Now, with data-sharing networks being established, these hidden activities face a much greater risk of exposure. This is good news for compliant participants, but a major blow to those operating in gray areas. Why could this affect prices? Because uncertainty is declining. Regulatory risk has long been a cloud hanging over cryptocurrency; now that cloud is shrinking, and some capital may flow into more heavily regulated assets as a result.

Impact on the market
In the short term, BTC and ETH may come under pressure. Why? Because all participants—including those moving illicit funds—now have a clearer sense that transaction records may be traced in the future. This expectation could prompt some capital to exit early. Historically, when the US CFTC began investigating cryptocurrency market makers in 2019, the market experienced a downturn. This time, the coordination is on a much larger scale, so the impact could be deeper. In the long term, however, this could help the market mature. Why? Because as tax evasion and money laundering decline, capital is more likely to flow into genuinely innovative businesses instead of being driven away by regulation. This could reshape the market landscape, pushing out exchanges and projects unable to meet regulatory requirements. In terms of capital flows, we may see a shift from centralized exchanges to compliant decentralized protocols.

Trading outlook
According to the data, ETH is down 0.50% over the past 24 hours, suggesting that the market has already begun to react. If France successfully advances this plan and encourages other countries and regions to follow suit, the cost of cryptocurrency compliance will rise significantly. This means that transactions will be more transparent in the future, which is good for the long-term value of BTC and ETH, but the market will need to absorb this regulatory pressure in the short term. This view would no longer hold if regulatory policies change course—for example, if certain countries oppose data sharing.

对市场意味着什么？简单说：监管透明度在提升。过去，很多交易发生在监管真空地带，现在随着数据共享网络建立，这些暗地里的活动将面临更大暴露风险。对合规玩家是好事，但对游走在灰色地带的人是重大打击。为什么这会影响价格？因为不确定性在减少。过去，监管风险是加密货币的长期阴霾，现在阴霾范围缩小了，部分资金可能因此流向更受监管的资产。

Thailand’s Supreme Court Criminal Ruling Confirms Bitcoin’s Status as Property

Southeast Asia’s judicial systems are gradually responding to new issues raised by crypto assets. On October 28, multiple media outlets reported that Thailand’s Supreme Court had ruled in criminal case No. 4929/2569 that Bitcoin constitutes property in the legal sense, drawing attention from the industry. The case was brought by the Samui Island Prosecutor’s Office. It began when a victim converted $50,000 (approximately 1.878 million baht) into Bitcoin and transferred it to a criminal group. The central issue was whether Bitcoin, which exists in electronic form, could be the object of an offense involving the infringement of “property” under criminal law. After hearing the case, the full bench of the Supreme Court held that Bitcoin has market value, can be bought and sold, can be exchanged for cash when there is a buyer, and can be possessed and controlled by the public. Therefore, the Bitcoin transferred by the victim was not “intangible and valueless data,” but property that could be the object of a property crime. Its value was not extinguished by its conversion from cash into Bitcoin. The ruling’s legal reasoning follows a clear chain: first, it establishes that Bitcoin has value, is transferable, and can be controlled; it then places Bitcoin within the category of property and ultimately finds that the elements of a property crime are satisfied. At the same time, the ruling clarifies a key distinction: the Bank of Thailand’s position that cryptocurrency is not legal tender for the discharge of debts is a separate issue from whether Bitcoin constitutes property. In other words, the court confirmed that Bitcoin can be property protected by law and subject to criminal infringement, but did not grant it legal tender status comparable to the Thai baht. Reports say the ruling cited Section 137 of Thailand’s Civil and Commercial Code, as well as Section 309, paragraph two; Section 340, paragraph one; and Section 340/3 of the Criminal Code. The ruling’s potential impact on the crypto market can be seen on three levels. First, recognizing crypto assets as property provides a clear legal basis for their judicial protection, making it more legally straightforward for victims to recover stolen assets and for law enforcement agencies to seize Bitcoin connected to crimes. Second, distinguishing property from legal tender leaves room for future regulatory frameworks: it recognizes the status of these assets without creating a conflict with the existing monetary system. Third, alongside earlier moves by Thai regulators to advance rules for crypto ETFs, this suggests that acceptance of digital assets in Thailand is progressing simultaneously through regulatory and judicial channels. Facts should be distinguished from speculation: the case details and key points of the ruling described above are verifiable facts; whether the ruling will significantly change participation in Thailand’s market or the pace at which regulated institutions establish operations remains speculative, pending validation through subsequent enforcement and supporting policies. What is clear is that, as major jurisdictions around the world increasingly recognize crypto assets as property, this Thai ruling offers another point of reference. Its long-term institutional significance outweighs its short-term impact on market sentiment.

东南亚司法体系正逐步回应加密资产带来的新问题。10月28日，据多家媒体报道，泰国最高法院在一宗刑事案件中作出第4929/2569号判决，认定比特币构成法律意义上的财产，引发行业关注。该案由苏梅岛检察院提起诉讼。案情起点是一名受害人将5万美元（约合187.8万泰铢）兑换为比特币后转给犯罪团伙。案件争议焦点在于：以电子形式存在的比特币，能否成为刑法意义上“财产被侵害”的对象。泰国最高法院全体法官审理后认为，比特币具有市场价值，可以买卖，在有买方的情况下可兑换为现金，公众能够持有和控制它。因此，受害人转出的比特币并非“无形且无价值的数据”，而是可构成财产犯罪对象的财产，其价值不因从现金转换为比特币而消灭。从法理逻辑看，判决的推理链条清晰：先确认比特币具备价值性、可交易性与可支配性三项特征，再将其纳入财产范畴，最终认定财产犯罪构成要件成立。同时，判决厘清了一个关键边界：泰国央行关于加密货币不属于法定偿债货币的立场，与比特币是否构成财产是两个不同问题。换言之，法院确认的是比特币可作为受法律保护、也可能被犯罪侵害的财产，而非赋予其类似泰铢的法定支付地位。据报道，判决援引了泰国《民商法典》第137条及《刑法》第309条第二款、第340条第一款与第340条之三。从加密市场的影响路径看，这一裁定主要体现在三个层面。其一，财产属性的确认为加密资产的司法保护提供明确依据，受害者追赃与执法机关查扣涉案比特币在法理上更为顺畅。其二，财产与法定货币的区分为后续监管框架留出空间，既承认资产属性，又不与现行货币体系冲突。其三，结合泰国监管机构此前推进加密ETF规则等动作，当地对数字资产的接纳正从监管与司法两条线同步推进。需要区分事实与推测：上述案件细节与判决要旨均有据可查，属已核实事实；而这一判决是否会明显改变泰国市场的参与度与合规机构布局节奏，目前仍属推测，有待后续执行与配套政策验证。可以确定的是，在全球主要司法辖区陆续承认加密资产财产属性的进程中，泰国这份判决提供了又一个可参照的样本，其长期制度意义大于短期情绪影响。

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

translatedData.title: How Is the Liquidation Price Calculated? A Guide to How Liquidation Works
translatedData.subTitle:
After opening a futures position, the app displays an “estimated liquidation price.” Where does this number come from?

【Simplified calculation】Take a 10x long position as an example: 100 U in capital, with a 1,000 U position. When losses eat into your margin,
(after deducting the maintenance margin requirement), liquidation is triggered. Roughly speaking, in cross-margin mode,
Liquidation distance ≈ 1 / leverage. 10x ≈ a 10% adverse move, 5x ≈ 20%, and 20x ≈ 5%.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 USDT control 1,000 USDT, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 USDT and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a position worth
1,000 USDT. If the coin’s price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal. In the other direction,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—remember, the loss is calculated based on your total position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin’s price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; it can all be gone after a move of about 10% (the exact point also depends on the margin ratio).

Ethereum contracts are usually written in Solidity or Vyper, compiled into bytecode, and deployed on-chain, where the EVM executes opcodes one by one.
The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the maximum stack depth is 1024.

When a contract is called on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for each instruction it executes, paid in $ETH .

translatedData.content:
Open the case files of a Thai court, and this time the dispute isn’t about whether prices are going up or down. It’s about this: does Bitcoin transferred under duress count as “property taken from someone”?

A full-bench Supreme Court ruling made public on October 28 (No. 4929/2569) set out the court’s position: Bitcoin has a market price, can be exchanged for cash, and can be possessed. It therefore meets the requirements for property under civil and commercial law and can be the object of property crimes such as robbery. The case was in Koh Samui: the victim was forced to convert about US$50,000 and transfer 2.480801 bitcoins, worth around 1.878 million baht at the time. The three courts upheld a ten-year prison sentence and ordered the return of the bitcoins or compensation in cash of equivalent value.

A few details that are easy to miss 👇

🔹 The ruling established Bitcoin’s status as property, but not as legal tender. It brought Bitcoin within the framework of property protection while drawing a clear line: it is not legal tender for settling debts, shops are not required to accept it, and the central bank’s position that “digital assets ≠ fiat currency” remains unchanged.

🔹 The defense had challenged whether electronic data has “intrinsic value.” The full bench cited the definition of cryptocurrency in the 2018 Emergency Decree on Digital Asset Businesses, emphasizing that it is a unit of electronic data that can be exchanged; if there is a buyer, it can be converted into cash. That means the elements of a property crime are met.

🔹 The remedy leaves an alternative: return 2.480801 BTC or pay equivalent cash compensation. If the coins have been dispersed and are difficult to trace on-chain, cash compensation is still an option, so victims won’t be unable to seek redress just because “the asset is on the blockchain.”

🔹 For ordinary people: if you are robbed or coerced into making a transfer in Thailand, the path to seeking restitution and compensation is now clearer. Whether payments can be made with crypto, how taxes are paid, and how exchange licenses are regulated are still governed by separate rules. Don’t mistake “counts as property” for “can be spent like baht.”

Put simply: this gives victims of crime a stronger basis under property law; it is not an order telling merchants they “must accept crypto.” If you hold crypto while traveling or doing business in Thailand, and something happens, the court will first recognize that “what you lost was property.” Everyday spending and tax treatment are separate matters.

If you faced a similar dispute there, would your first move be to report it to the police and try to trace the coins, or to calculate their cash value and claim compensation? Let’s talk in the comments 👇

打开泰国法院的卷宗，这回争的不是涨跌，而是：被逼转走的比特币，算不算「被人抢走的东西」。

10 月 28 日公开的最高法院全席判决（编号 4929/2569）给出口径——比特币有市场报价、能兑成现金、也能被持有，满足民商法对财产的要件，可以成为抢劫等财产犯罪的对象。案子在苏梅岛：被害人遭胁迫，把约 5 万美元换成 2.480801 枚比特币转出，当时约合 187.8 万泰铢；三审维持十年有期徒刑，并责令返还这批币，或以等值现金赔偿。

几个容易被忽略的细节👇

🔹 财产身份先落锤，法币身份没给。判决把比特币接进财产保护框架，同时划清：它不是法定偿债货币，商店没有义务收款，央行「数字资产≠法币」的立场也没被推翻。

🔹 辩方曾咬「电子数据有没有内在价值」。全席引用 2018 年《数字资产事业紧急命令》对加密货币的定义，强调它是可交换的电子数据单位，有买方就能换成现金——因此财产犯罪构成要件成立。

🔹 执行留了退路：退回 2.480801 BTC，或按等值现金赔。币已分散、链上难追时，现金替代仍可走，受害方不会因为「东西在链上」就卡死求偿。

🔹 对普通人：在泰国遇到盗抢、胁迫转账，主张返还和索赔的路径更清楚。支付能不能刷、税怎么交、交易所牌照怎么管，仍看另一套监管细则，别把「属财产」听成「能当泰铢花」。

说白了：这是给刑事受害方补的一张财产法底牌，不是给商户下的「必须收币」通知。持币去泰国旅游或办事，出事时法院先认你「丢的是财产」；日常消费和税务口径，还是分开看。

如果在当地碰到类似纠纷，你第一反应会先报警追币，还是先换算成现金索赔？评论区聊聊👇

ETH Falls to $2,327 | Fund Outflows and Rate Decision in Focus | I’m Waiting for Two Confirmations

My stance is to remain cautious. Today, you can’t assess ETH solely by whether it follows BTC’s rebound. The Federal Reserve’s official website confirms that its rate-setting meeting is scheduled for October 27–28, and the decision had still not been announced as of writing. The #FOMC meeting remains a hot topic on Binance Square, but “what the market is betting on” and “what the central bank announces” are two different things. Overnight fund data are also worth looking at separately: Farside shows net outflows of about $60.2 million from U.S. spot ETH funds in total on October 27, while BTC funds saw total net inflows of $176 million that day. The figures for individual ETH funds on the 28th have not yet been reported. The 0.0 shown as the webpage’s total simply indicates that it hasn’t been updated; it should not be reported as zero outflows for the day.

This divergence does not amount to a straightforward bearish signal for ETH. ETF subscriptions and redemptions reflect marginal demand through a specific institutional channel and cannot represent all spot trading across the market. But when BTC is seeing net inflows while ETH continues to see outflows, ETH needs confirmation from spot prices and subsequent fund data to establish independent strength. If the rate decision changes expectations for the path of interest rates, it could affect the dollar, risk-asset valuations, and the cost of leverage at the same time. Because ETH is more volatile, its short-term reaction could be sharper than BTC’s. This is a risk scenario, not grounds for attributing a decline to a policy decision that has not yet been announced.

The market reaction is already reflected in prices. Kraken ETH/USD was just quoted at about $2,326.84, below the day’s opening price of $2,347.12; the intraday low was $2,319.54 and the high was $2,383.77. BTC was around $80,392 over the same period, also below its daily open of $80,800.90. Both coins falling indicates pressure on overall risk appetite, but it doesn’t prove that ETH fund outflows were the sole cause of this decline over the past several minutes. I’m watching to see whether the $2,320 area repeatedly gives way, and whether ETH can reclaim the $2,347 opening level. If it briefly moves above $2,347 only to quickly fall back below, the rebound is not convincing. If it breaks below $2,319 and losses widen, the short-term recovery thesis is invalidated.

The Ethereum Foundation previously announced that the activation of Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet, originally scheduled for October 26, has been delayed, with no new date given yet. A change to the testnet schedule is a project-timeline update; it should not be misreported as an upgrade to mainnet, nor is it enough on its own to explain every fluctuation in today’s spot price. My trading priority remains to wait for the rate decision first, then see whether fund flows and price action align. If fund data are revised later, or the policy wording differs from market expectations, I’ll reassess rather than cling to an outdated narrative.

If I were trading this myself, I’d sit out for now and keep only a small spot long on the table as a possible direction. The trigger would be ETH regaining and holding above $2,347 after the rate statement, with the level holding on a retest, while BTC does not continue weakening. If those conditions are met, I’d use no more than 2.5% of my total capital to test the position. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,365, close the rest near the second target of $2,383, and set a stop-loss below $2,319. If spreads widen when the announcement comes out, the price gaps past my planned entry zone, or ETH funds continue to see significant outflows while the price fails to hold, I’d rather stay in cash than gamble on a move with high leverage.

ETH回落至2327美元｜基金流出与议息同场｜我等两道确认

我的态度是保持谨慎，今天的ETH不能只看它有没有跟随BTC反弹。美联储官网确认10月27至28日召开议息会议，本次结果截至写稿仍未发布。币安广场#FOMC会议仍是高讨论话题，但“市场押注什么”与“央行宣布什么”是两回事。隔夜的资金数据也值得单独看：Farside显示美国现货ETH基金10月27日合计净流出约6020万美元，而同日BTC基金合计净流入1.76亿美元。28日ETH各基金栏位尚未填报，网页合计显示的0.0只是未更新状态，不能写成当日零流出。

这组分化对ETH的含义不是简单利空。ETF申赎反映特定机构渠道的边际需求，不能代表全市场所有现货买卖；但当BTC有资金净流入、ETH仍净流出，ETH要走出独立强势，就更需要现货价格和后续基金数据共同确认。议息声明若改变利率路径预期，可能同时影响美元、风险资产估值和杠杆成本；ETH由于波动较大，短时反应可能比BTC更剧烈。这里的机制是风险推演，不能把尚未公布的政策决定当作下跌原因。

title: 浮盈不是利润：合约交易中“守”比“赚”难在哪里
subTitle:
#BTC #ETH #BNB 做合约的人大多有过这样的时刻：账户浮盈拉到50%，你盯着K线，心里清楚“该走了”，手指却没有动。你告诉自己“再拿一会儿”。然后行情反转，浮盈缩水，你更不想走了——刚才都没走，现在走不是亏了？再然后，浮盈归零，甚至倒亏。你终于平仓，骂一句“狗庄”，关掉屏幕。
问题从来不在于你看错了方向。问题在于，你把浮盈当成了利润。
浮盈是市场借给你的，不是你的
一个被反复验证却反复被忽视的事实是：账户里的浮盈，在你平仓之前，从来不属于你。 它只是市场暂时放在你账户上的一个数字，随时可以收回。真正属于你的，只有已经落袋的那部分。
更麻烦的是，浮盈会改变你对风险的感知。连续盈利之后，人最容易高估自己。原来一笔只愿意亏20U，赚了几笔之后觉得“亏50U也没关系”。仓位放大了，交易频率提高了，原来一天两三单，后来一天十几单，看见波动就想进去。结果往往是不到三天，前面赚的全部还回去。盈利不是让你加倍冒险的底气，而是提醒你继续遵守纪律的理由。
利润回撤的数学，比你想象的残酷
亏损和回本从来不是对称的。亏10%，需要涨约11%回本；亏20%，需要涨25%；亏50%，需要涨100%。在合约里叠加杠杆，这个不对称会被急剧放大。一次失控的回撤，消耗的不只是资金，还有你下一次冷静出手所需的心态空间。
这就是为什么“守住利润”在合约交易中的权重，远高于“多赚一点”。先控制亏损，再考虑盈利，能长期留在牌桌上，比一时赚得多更重要。而守利润的第一道防线，是在浮盈还在的时候，把它的一部分变成不可逆的已实现收益。
第一层防御：让工具替你做决定
靠意志力在浮盈面前做理性决策，是合约交易中最不可靠的事。止盈止损工具的核心价值，恰恰在于用预设规则替代持仓中的情绪判断。
移动止盈止损是锁定趋势利润的基础工具。它的逻辑并不复杂：止损触发价跟随价格朝有利方向移动，价格继续涨，保护位跟着上移；价格一旦回调达到预设幅度，自动市价平仓。普通固定止盈保护的是一个预设价位，移动止损保护的是动态的利润边界，更适合趋势行情中“让利润奔跑，但不让利润跑光”。在趋势市场中，它也是处理爆发性顶部或重大突破后回撤的主要方式之一。
一个可以直接参考的浮盈保护节奏是：浮盈10%时把止损移到成本线，浮盈20%先锁定10%的收益，浮盈30%至少留住15%的利润。关键不在于参数本身，而在于在开仓时就预设好“利润到哪一步，保护跟到哪一步” ，而不是等浮盈出现后再临时决定。
第二层防御：分批，而不是赌一个点
一次性全平的问题在于，你在用全部利润赌“这就是顶”。分批止盈解决的正是这个矛盾：在不同价位逐步减仓，既锁定部分利润，又保留仓位去博弈后续空间。
具体操作上，可以在原定止盈目标的一半位置先减仓一次，到达目标位后再决定剩余仓位是全部离场还是留一部分“格局”。这样做的心理效果往往比数学效果更重要：当一部分利润已经落袋，剩余仓位对回撤的容忍度会显著上升，你不再因为害怕“全部还回去”而过早砍掉一个本来还能走的趋势，也不至于因为死等一个点而把利润全部交还。
分批的本质，是承认你无法精确预测顶部，但你可以让自己在“对了”的时候多拿一些，在“错了”的时候少还一些。
第三层防御：盈利之后，主动收缩风险敞口
比工具和技法更深一层的问题，是盈利之后的行为变异。赚了钱之后加大仓位、提高频率、放宽止损，几乎是合约交易中最普遍的自我毁灭路径。
真正能长期做下去的人，做法往往相反：赚得越顺，越不会随意放大单笔风险。原来怎么做，还是怎么做。连续盈利之后主动减仓，而不是加仓，因为赚钱的时候人最容易高估自己。每一笔交易仍然提前确定退出条件，不拿浮盈当成扛单的资本。
还有一条容易被忽略但极其有效的规则：把一部分利润从交易账户里拿走。 赚到的钱及时出金，不要全部重新投回市场；大部分暂时用不到的资金单独存放，减少冲动补仓的机会。一个更具体的节奏是：账户利润达到本金的10%时，提取其中一半到冷钱包，剩下的利润继续在市场里工作。这不是对行情悲观的判断，而是对“账户里的钱会被自己冲动花掉”这一人性弱点的承认。
最难的一层：把“收手”变成一种能力
以上所有规则，最终都指向同一个动作：在还可以继续赚的时候，选择先守住已经有的。
这反人性。连续抓住几波行情之后，脑子里最容易冒出来的念头是“趁热打铁”，而不是“够了”。但交易做到最后，比拼的不是谁赚得最猛，而是谁能够把利润留在账户里，留到下一轮行情。那些在这个市场活得久的人，靠的不是每次都猜对方向，而是猜错的时候也输得起，以及在猜对之后不把赢来的全部押回去。
把每一次盈利都当成市场暂时借给你的钱，只有真正落袋，才算赚到。这句话听起来保守，但在一个杠杆会同时放大收益和愚蠢的市场里，保守是唯一可持续的进攻姿态。
守住利润，说到底不是一种技巧，而是一种纪律：在浮盈面前，主动选择做一个“赚得不够多”的人，以便不做那个“全部还回去”的人。

Now you’re even less willing to exit—after not selling when you had the chance, wouldn’t selling now mean taking a loss? Then your gains disappear, and you’re even down overall. You finally close your position, mutter, “Damn market makers,” and turn off the screen.
The problem was never that you read the market direction wrong. The problem was that you mistook unrealized gains for profit.
Unrealized gains are loaned to you by the market. They’re not yours.
